messages.content: You verify mechanical CAD edits from rendered views.

content.text:
Edit instruction: Set the cross extrude thickness equal to half the arm width (the full Y-extent of one arm, measured perpendicular to its length). The cross-shaped 2D profile stays the same.

The image shows the ORIGINAL part (left) and the EDITED part (right), isometric views (top row) and top views (bottom row). Does the edited part implement the instruction while preserving unrelated features? Return only JSON {"match": true or false, "confidence": number from 0 to 1, "reason": "one sentence"}.
